notes.title: HUGE PC UPDATE - STEAM DECK - NINTENDO LIVE
notes.content:
MAJOR UPDATE - Welcome to Arcade Tycoon 2.0
[url=https://discord.gg/QbgsEBkc5m]DISCORD CLICK HERE[/url]

To celebrate the launch of Arcade Tycoon on Nintendo Switch, we are so excited to share with you Arcade Tycoon 2.0! Our biggest update yet.

In Short
✔️ Available on Nintendo Switch 🍄
✔️ Improved Steam Deck Playability 🎮
✔️ Huge PC Update 🖥️

[u][b]Now available on Nintendo Switch![/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32843451/7aa8343513ccb1c8e4ffa54c296922ef3baf6437.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Fully operational on the new Steam Deck![/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32843451/41030e4649f39750a75873b6ed2f140cd39fd398.png[/img]

[u][b]Huge improvements to the UI design and usability of the game. [/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32843451/b727395ece83030494adf0674d60d595b91ef10b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32843451/dde27db20b7ce16e5759a74776cdc6862537ca42.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32843451/522eb437568cac00af808b98f8ce0d0fd28f94f9.jpg[/img]

Find below a list of things to expect in this update.

[b]UI[/b]

Each menu has been re-designed to provide a consistent visual appearance across the entire game. Here are some of the main ones you need to know about.
[list]
[*] [b]HUD[/b]: A cleaner and more streamlined look while still providing the critical information you need.
[*] [b]Overview[/b]: Your new go-to menu for everything about your Arcade. Here you'll find your Research tab alongside Finance and Analytics and much more.
[*] [b]Build[/b]: Everything you need to build is now in one place. Building out your Arcade has never been so simple.
[*] [b]Hire[/b]: Need some assistance, check out the Hire menu. Here you'll find all your favourite Staff ready to be hired.
[*] [b]Summaries[/b]: The Summaries screen is back, with a new lick of paint and even more information.
[/list]

[b]Controller Support[/b]
[list]
[*] Whether you're on the go with your Steam Deck or just fancy kicking back with a controller in hand, it has never been easier to build and manage your Arcade.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] Customers will now want to play on your machines more often and for longer periods of time.
[*] Reworked the Prize Station to generate Stars but be careful of raging customers.
[*] All machines now have a repair cost. This cost increases the more damaged the machine.
[*] Staff have had significant changes ranging from cost to overall ability. Each Staff type now costs differing amounts with security being the cheapest and technicians the most expensive.
[*] Campaign objectives have been rebalanced to stop bank loans from providing easy completions.
[*] Bank loans now have a set repayment schedule.
[*] Capped Bank Interest at $10k.
[*] Added the ability to hold the "ALT" key to quick-sell or power machines off.
[/list]

[b]Localisation[/b]
[list]
[*] All current languages have been updated for the new update.
[/list]

[b]Sound[/b]
[list]
[*] Brand New Soundtracks have been added to the game.
[*] Lots of new UI sounds have been implemented when navigating menus.
[/list]

[b]Tutorial[/b]
[list]
[*] A New Tutorial to help whether you're a Veteran Arcade Manager or just starting out.
[*] Meet Rex the dog and allow him to talk you through the opening tutorial. (Audio only available in English localisation.)
[/list]

[b]Optimisation[/b]
[list]
[*] A whole bunch of improvements have been made ranging from reduced memory consumption to increased framerate. The game is now more lightweight and easier to run.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] We've fixed and added and fixed even more bugs in the 18 months since our last update. If you found a bug in our last update, I think it is safe to assume that it's probably been fixed.
[*] If you find a bug in this update, then let us know.
[/list]

[url=https://discord.gg/QbgsEBkc5m]DISCORD CLICK HERE[/url]

notes.title: #20 Major Update - 40+ Bug Fixes, Changes - Campaign carries stars, unlocks etc
notes.content:
Hey Arcadians! ːsteamhappyː
Discord [url=https://discord.gg/cHZgPfn]Come Come Come Join Us 500+ Members[/url]

Your favourite Arcade Tycoon Developers are back with another update. Some pesky bugs have shown up and we felt it was time to step back in a squash them. We've also made a couple of big changes to the game which we hope you will like.

One of the changes is that Stars are now persistent across all Campaign levels. This means you only need to unlock your favourite research just once to get it throughout the campaign. The same also applies to unlocking higher-tier Arcade types. Any Stars built up will show up on any campaign level for your profile.

We've also created a system that will backdate the Stars, Research and Arcade Types earned through an existing campaign. This is done through an analyzing screen that shows up the first time you load the game or change to an old profile for the first time.

Another exciting change is to how you build carpets, gone are the days of manually placing each floor tile. You can drag select up to a 12x12 region to place down your majestic flooring.

As usual, you can find all the fixes and new additions down below.

--------------------------------------------
~ Added arrow indicators to the Arcade Rating Panel that now show when values increase or decrease.
~ Added persistent Stars to the campaign mode. Research, unlocked machines and Stars will now carry over for each level. On first first-time loads, your saves will be analysed to determine stars earned over past arcades.
~ Added text and slightly adjusted the layout of the repair buttons in the Machine Panel to help with communication.
~ Added the ability to place down flooring by drag selecting an area.
~ Adjusted the amount of XP entertainers gains to no longer be dependent on the number of customers affected.
~ Adjusted the contract "Stay in shallow debt" criteria to now consider all debt as progress.
~ Adjusted the descriptions of some Contracts to better communicate their required trigger parameters.
~ Contracts will now display a failure message instead of just disappearing.
~ Decor appeal values will now appear when placing Decorations.
~ Decorating walls and floors now provides more visual feedback.
~ Fixed a bug that allowed an already ongoing contract to appear again in the available list.
~ Fixed a bug that allowed infinite money in any of the campaign levels.
~ Fixed a bug that allowed Pictures to be purchased for no cost.
~ Fixed a bug that caused customers to incorrectly display the wrong though when looking for a missing token machine.
~ Fixed a bug that caused Entertainer balloons to stack unintentionally.
~ Fixed a bug that caused Entertainers to always drop balloons with the Cheer-Spread perk.
~ Fixed a bug that caused Entertainers to not be removed from the hire list when hired.
~ Fixed a bug that caused Staff Wages to calculate incorrectly when promoting.
~ Fixed a bug that caused the "Decorate Walls & Floor" Objective to not complete if the shift key was used when decorating.
~ Fixed a bug that caused the appeal rating to not update when buying a new plot of land in Sandbox mode.
~ Fixed a bug that caused the Arcade Rating screen to show Drinks by default.
~ Fixed a bug that caused the Checklist to show even after turning it off in the options.
~ Fixed a bug that caused the Entertainer to not disable certain perks in certain situations.
~ Fixed a bug that caused Utilities to charge a Star cost when upgrading.
~ Fixed a bug with contracts that caused the progress of contracts already completed to not be reset, resulting in automatic completion when selected again.
~ Fixed a bug with the Organised Robbery event in Sandbox that caused it to sometimes not trigger.
~ Fixed a bug with the Staff Notification that caused them to display as duplicates rather than Staff specific ones.
~ Fixed a visual bug that occurred when attempting to place down a machine which you can't afford.
~ Fixed a visual bug with Food and Drink windows incorrectly displaying their respective Values.
~ Fixed a visual bug with the Staff Room which incorrectly stated the number and type of staff present.
~ Increased the reward for the Contract "Level up a member of staff to 20".
~ Lowered the frequency at which Low Power Notifications appear.
~ Raging customers will now break fewer machines before leaving.
~ Selecting an arcade to build will now cause it to show up immediately.
~ Text will now appear when building machines stating the new and cost.
~ Unique machines now have a repair cost.
--------------------------------------------

Thanks for reading and supporting Arcade Tycoon.
~The Devs

notes.title: MEGA UPDATE - Mascots - Rage Quit! - Contracts - Tutorial - Bugfixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32843451/74d053938f0139dc1d6e6ed0ef192c049a2a4e03.jpg[/img]
Once again we where officially selected by the famous TINYTEAM festival, thanks for everyone who purchased the game and gave feedback to support us!

We have had some big and small reviewers contact us about are game which is coming out very soon 14th OCT, if you wish to review this game please contact [url=arcade-tycoon@mail.com]arcade-tycoon@mail.com[/url]

Come say hi [url=https://discord.gg/HTYaJJR]DISCORD HERE [/url]

Welcome back to another update for Arcade Tycoon.
It's only been a few months since our last update, but we've been hard at work adding more content and finishing up some of the major features in the game.

Contracts are a new feature that we are very excited to have now in the game. You can choose from a list of contracts that provide cash and star rewards for completing, and for every 5 contracts that you complete, you gain a Contract Coin which can be used to purchase a unique machine.

We've also overhauled our pause system. With this new system, you can now perform a lot more actions including moving and placing machines as well as redecorating. This change will give you no excuse now to build the perfect arcade without the worry of a ticking clock.

Another new addition to the game is the Entertainer, this new Staff Type will roam around your arcade bringing joy and happiness to all while providing a nice boost to your appeal.
DINO - COWBOY - MONSTER - ROBOT

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32843451/44ad3ed1765feb8a81cdd4aa7d28af95ecd8d456.gif[/img]

The tutorial has been reworked to bring it back up to date with the game. We've also made it easier to read while providing you with the information needed to run a successful arcade.

On top of all this, we've worked tirelessly on adding more tooltips, hints and quality of life changes to the game, as well as fixing numerous bugs.
Onto the patch notes:

~ Added a "Dummies Checklist" to Sandbox and the Tutorial level to help players understand the basic needs of an arcade. (This can be disabled in the options menu.)
~ Added a bunch of new announcements.
~ Added a Decor rating to each decoration in the Buy menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32843451/5cdde3b99d8b8997b6d59992b145189a2733c6cd.jpg[/img]
~ Added a new random event called "Rage Quit" that causes customers to go into a fit of rage damaging and destroying your machines.
~ Added a new window inside the Objectives menu called Contracts that you can now complete for a set of rewards like Cash, Stars and access to Unique Machines!
~ Added a Portaloo toilet.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32843451/2e127c537d8b410c553da03cd9a0d01bebde53ff.png[/img]
~ Added a screen shake that occurs when an Arcade explodes.
~ Added an animation when on low power and slightly changed the design of the power bar.
~ Added balloons that can now be dropped by an Entertainer with the Cheer-Spread Perk that increases your decor rating.
~ Added some more sounds to various buttons.
~ Added the "Entertainer" staff type. They will roam your arcade entertaining customers and boosting your appeal rating.
~ Changed "Engineers/Mechanics" to now be called "Technicians".
~ Changed "External Handyman" to now be called "Specialist".
~ Changed both of the "Fuse" Unlockables to now be part of their own upgrade tree.
~ Changed the repair button in the Machine select view to now be a togglable button that switches between 3 modes; External Specialist Repair, Staff Prioritize and Normal.
~ Changed Unique Machines to now cost Contract Coins! Completing 5 contracts awards you with one Coin!
~ Customers can now occasionally get annoyed at machines and kick them in a rage.
~ Fixed a bug that allowed Staff to be upgraded more times than they should be.
~ Fixed a bug that caused Cleaners to get stuck when told to take a break.
~ Fixed a bug that caused Prime Candidates to not start with the correct amount of XP.
~ Fixed a bug that caused some announcements to not appear.
~ Fixed a bug that caused some staff members to not show their correct level.
~ Fixed a bug that caused the Sandbox map to not update the appeal values correctly when buying new land.
~ Fixed a bug that caused tiles on certain maps to not set the correct Decor Appeal Value.
~ Fixed a bug that occasionally caused Technicians to get stuck when called in to repair a Token Machine or ATM.
~ Fixed a bug with ATM that caused customers to get stuck queuing for them.
~ Fixed an issue that occasionally caused the Small Toilet to clip through other machines.
~ Improved the feedback on machine cost tooltips.
~ Increased the cost of upgrading Machines from "Terrible" to "Unreliable" quality.
~ Management Tools will now automatically close more often.
~ Rebalanced some of the decoration prices and benefits.
~ Rebalanced the cost of Token Machines and ATMs.
~ Reworked the tutorial to be shorter and easier to follow.
~ Slightly tweaked the sizing, proportions and positions of some menus and buttons to make for a better layout.
~ Staff will no longer quit if they are walking to the Staff Room for a break.
~ The basic Token Machine now has a reliability of "Terrible".
~ The game no longer pauses when requesting a Specialist.
~ Unique Machine "Flushed Away" now consumes 500 power.
~ Unique Machines can no longer be abducted by aliens.
~ You can now perform a lot more actions while paused which include building machines, hiring staff and decorating your arcade.

And that's everything. We're super excited with the direction the game is going and we hope you are too. As always, if you have any suggestions or find a bug, then let us know on our Discord or Steam forums.

The Devs.

Your support helps us continue making this game better!

notes.title: MONSTER UPDATE - 97 Changes!
notes.content:
Hey @everyone

I'm back with another brand new update and be warned, this one is our biggest one yet.

We've counted 97 unique changes, which range from several major bugs fixes to a brand new currency system.

In this system, you will earn Stars from customers playing on machines, which can be used to unlock different styles of arcade, as well as purchasing upgrades from the Research and Development screen.

Speaking of Research and Development, we've added 12 new upgrades that will help you get the best possible price for arcades or help your Staff in keeping on top of their jobs.

Another major addition to this update is our new and improved AI. We've redesigned how customers will interact with your arcade. Amongst many changes, a noticeable one is each customer now has a favourite machine type that they love to play, doing so will provide a greater happiness boost to the arcade. They'll also quickly get bored of playing the same machine, so make sure to provide lots of variety or your customers will become unhappy.

A few other major additions include a new customer as well as a trends window, which will display which Arcade is currently trending for that quarter of the year. Trending arcades work similar to favourite arcades and will provide a boost in happiness.

Onto the patch notes.

~ Added a "Trends" window to the HUD accessible via the date button, this shows the previous trend, current trend and the ability to reveal the upcoming trend. Trends change every 3 Months.
~ Added a Happiness bar to Arcade machines inside the purchase menus that show how much happiness the machine generates.
~ Added a level name and rent to Sandbox map.
~ Added a new animation to the Staff Room to help better show which staff utility you have selected.
~ Added a new announcement that appears when the staff list is refreshed.
~ Added a new Character.
~ Added a new Random Event called "Short Circuit".
~ Added a new Researchable Upgrade "Automated Fusebox".
~ Added a new Researchable Upgrade "Bootleg Parts".
~ Added a new Researchable Upgrade "CCTV".
~ Added a new Researchable Upgrade "Footfall Scheme".
~ Added a new Researchable Upgrade "Lightning Rod".
~ Added a new Researchable Upgrade "Loyalty Card".
~ Added a new Researchable Upgrade "Marketing Markdown".
~ Added a new Researchable Upgrade "Prime Candidates".
~ Added a new Researchable Upgrade "Staff Wage Reduction".
~ Added a new Researchable Upgrade "Utility Improvements".
~ Added a new Researchable Upgrade "x3 Speed".
~ Added a new Researchable Upgrade "x4 Speed".
~ Added a Star bar to the Arcade machines inside the purchase menus that shows how many stars it generates.
~ Added a tooltip to Difficulty showing its effects.
~ Added a tooltip to toilets and bins to correctly show "clean" and "empty"
~ Added a visual inside Food and Drink that now shows the average Satisfaction from each Stall/Machine.
~ Added customer "Favourite Machine" types, customers now have a favourite machine type that they prefer playing over other types.
~ Added more feedback for actions that were not completable due to being short on cash, it should be a little more obvious now.
~ Added some new announcements for Firing staff and when a new trend starts.
~ Added some new information to the Arcade select views including information on how many Stars and how much happiness it generates.
~ Added some new tooltips to various UI screens.
~ Added some sound new sound effects for staff.
~ Added Stars to the HUD.
~ Added the ability to increase the number of stars a machine generates through upgrades.
~ Added the ability to multi-paint wallpapers by holding shift.
~ Added two new Summary sections in the summary screen for Food & Drink as well as Utilities.
~ ATM, Token Machines and Toilets now follow the same formula for calculating the upgrade cost as Arcades do.
~ Changed customer need sliders to an alternate dial marker for better readability.
~ Changed the percentages or Marketing schemes to better indicate how far through a scheme you are.
~ Changed the Power Generator screen, now allowing you to buy infinite amounts of power.
~ Changed the rubbish picker tool to now enter Transparent View mode.
~ Changed the way that Marketing calculates how far through a scheme it is, each scheme now runs from the moment you buy it and ends after the correct length of time.
~ Cleaners will now empty bins if they are nearby.
~ Cleaners will now only consider cleaning a toilet when its maintenance drops below 50%.
~ Enabled and updated ATM & Token Machine Upgrade for Armours 10%->20%, 20%->50%.
~ Enabled the empty button for Rubbish bins.
~ Fixed a bug on the Staff Room screen with the exit button.
~ Fixed a bug that would sometimes cause the "Staff level up arrow" to show on the HUD even when no upgrades were available.
~ Fixed a bug that caused customers to indefinitely complaining about a lack of ATM's rather than just leaving.
~ Fixed a bug that caused external mechanics and employed mechanics to fix the same machine at the same time.
~ Fixed a bug that caused Staff to sometimes lose the perk you're trying to retrain.
~ Fixed a bug that caused the High Rollers to spawn without being counted into the arcade.
~ Fixed a bug that caused the upgrade arrow to remain on the screen when a staff member quits.
~ Fixed a bug which caused toilets to sometimes be cleaned by multiple cleaners at the same time.
~ Fixed a bug that occasionally caused customers to get stuck.
~ Fixed a bug that occasionally stopped you from selecting a new perk for staff.
~ Fixed a bug that stopped all the saves of a deleted profile from being removed.
~ Fixed a bug which was causing Staff Rooms to incorrectly count the number of Staff after a save and load.
~ Fixed a bug with machine rotation when holding shift.
~ Fixed a bug with Marketing that caused schemes to not run after a save and load.
~ Fixed a bug with marketing that caused some schemes to not correctly influence the customer spawn rate.
~ Fixed a bug with Mechanics/Cleaners which sometimes caused machines/toilets to no longer be able to be fixed.

notes.title: Staff Update Major 12# with new character.
notes.content:
Hope you are all well and excited for the Holiday Season.

I'm here with the final update of the year which will provide some big new features.

The first major addition is all to do with Staff members. They have too long been in the shadows repairing machines, cleaning up rubbish and keeping out thieves. 

Staff now have Needs, Stats, Perks and Flaws:
~ Needs are similar to customer needs, and staff will get cranky if you don't provide a place for them to rest and relax.
~ Stats now drive how good your staff member performs certain actions. They are split into 3 categories, Skill (How fast or well they work), Speed (How quickly they move around) and Stamina (How long they can work without a break).
~ Perks are bonus skills that you can give a staff member. They can provide unique traits or an extra boost to stats.
~ Flaws are the opposite of perks. These can develop over time and will hinder your staff.

On top of this, Staff will now gain XP which you can use to upgrade your staff member. We've also added a Staff Room which you can build to give your Staff a place to take a much-deserved break.

To finish out the update, we've added a new customer who will start showing up at your arcade, a staff summary screen to help you keep track, as well as a whole host of bug fixes and improvements which you can see below.

Patch Notes
~ Added a large selection of Perks to staff members that are generated in the Staff Hire window, you are also able to award your staff members new perks once they gain enough experience to level up!
~ Added a new character.
~ Added a new decoration just in time for the Christmas season.
~ Added a new Random Event called "High Rollers".
~ Added a new window that allows you to see all staff members in a list and Select them (Staff Summary).
~ Added a Staff Room that your staff are now able to visit when their needs fall low, complete with upgrades.
~ Added a Staff Wage info string to the staff select menu.
~ Added an animation to the Marketing screen that now plays when you can't afford a program.
~ Added functionality to the "Bonus" button which for a cost, grants staff a temporary boost to needs to allow them to continue working longer!
~ Added new buttons to the HUD for both the Staffroom and the Staff Summary.
~ Added the Staffroom button to the HUD.
~ Fixed a bug which caused the pickup button to be replaced with Alert for spanners and cleaners.
~ Fixed a bug which caused the Staff select view to be removed occasionally.
~ Fixed a bug which occasionally caused a customer to get stuck.
~ Fixed a bug which stopped Lightning from appearing.
~ Fixed a major bug caused by reloading a save.
~ Fixed several occurrences of the mouse click leaking through to certain menus.
~ Implemented Staff Needs, these dictate how effective your staff members are while working.
~ Rebalanced some audio volumes.
~ Rebalanced the price of the Arcade durability upgrades.
~ Rebalanced the Unlockables Repair Speed Upgrades.
~ Removed the heat haze effect.
~ Reworked Staff Needs and Skills.
~ Reworked Staff wages, they are now calculated based on the "Level" that they generate at and their Stats & Skillset.
~ Reworked the Staff select screen.
~ Staff members in hired in a previous version will have its stats re-rolled based on the new system.
~ Staff will now gain experience when performing various tasks, once enough experience is gained your staff members increase in level, certain tasks will grant more experience.
~ Upgrading a staff member will increase their monthly wage.

We've worked extra hard to get this update out in time for the holiday season, however, bugs will do buggy things. So if you spot one, let us know through both our discord and Steam forums.

Finally, the team here at Arcade Tycoon would like to wish you a Merry Christmas and a happy new year.

notes.title: MEGA LOCKDOWN UPDATE 45 Updates/Fixes - Research Tree - Save System
notes.content:
Discord https://discord.gg/HTYaJJR

Hey @everyone, 

As always we hope you are all keeping safe and well. We've been hard at work putting together the latest update 0.7.0 for Arcade Tycoon on Steam for you all! This update sees some pretty exciting and new game mechanics and features that we hope that you'll enjoy testing out. 

The two main features of this update include a completely overhauled Happiness system. This changes the way your Happiness score is calculated, meaning that it now takes into account every customer that has ever visited your arcade. 

The second main feature is a completely new Save System! This new system will allow you to create multiple profiles with their own separate campaigns allowing you to make countless level saves! Due to the way that the new system works it now means that any saves made from v0.6.1 and before will no longer be compatible with any future updates. 

We understand however that a lot of you may still want to continue playing on your already existing saves, regarding this, we have made the decision to continue to host v0.6.1 on a separate Steam Beta branch. The 0.6.1 version can be accessed by going to the properties tab for Arcade Tycoon in your steam library. Then select the Betas tab and pick the 0.6.1 version from the drop-down list.

Now on to the patch notes --------------------------- 
~ Added a Cleaner Bot you can employ to automatically clean the litter in your arcade.

[*] Fixed a bug which caused customers to get stuck interacting with Food and Drink machines.
[*] Fixed a bug which caused staff members to work for free on loading a save. (Unfortunately old saves will still have staff members working for free, Fire and rehire to fix this.)
[*] Added a Tiny Toilet for those wanting a more slimline arcade.
[*] Added sounds for Retro arcade machines.

Changelog
---------------------------------
Added Campaign mode!
Added 12 new levels!
Added Objectives!
Added Objective Notifications
Changed location from which customers access vending machines.
Changed the Handyman and Security portraits.
Changed the thought feed to differentiate whether the player had token machines or they were occupied.
Fixed another bug with picking up machines while a customer is moving to it.
Fixed the size of the door, so it now properly aligns with the floor width.
Fixed a lot of issues with achievements which stopped them from being obtained.
Fixed an issue with modern machines when save and loading.
Fixed an issue which stopped utility, food and drink machines from updating their total users and turnover.
Fixed customers getting stuck when decorations are built on top of them.
Fixed a bug when rotating machines on initial purchase not saving their previous rotation state if they are moved to an occupied space.
Fixed a bug when attempting to move food and drink to a position that was invalid causing it to be moved back inaccurately.
Added Announcements for various levels of cash income and happiness.
Added Tax for each year as well as an Announcement to go with it.
Added a "Thoughts:" tag in the customer HUD to more clearly show thoughts.
Fixed a bug which resulted in red queue tiles being left behind after selling a machine.
Fixed an issue that caused the floor to break when loading after pressing the resume.
Fixed a few bugs due to failing to move a machine.
Fixed a bug which stopped staff from receiving wages after a save and load.
Fixed the land plots in sandbox resetting back to the original price after save and load.
Fixed explosion SFX not playing for machines when they break.
QoL - Hold shift when placing a machine to immediately place another.
QoL - Added transparency to the blue floor when building.
Fixed a bug that stopped progression on level 5.
Fixed a bug which stopped certain arcade menus from showing.
Added some flavour to the map select screen.
Fixed a duplication bug with the shift click building.
Fixed a bug which made certain place able objects invisible until rotated.
Fixed the meltdown announcement not being dismissed.
Fixed a texture error with the rubber plant.
Added achievements for objectives.
Added some popup dialogues to make transitions easier.
Added a transparency mode.
Loading now loads the most recent save for the level you are on.
Fixed a pathing bug in Haunted Hotel.
Fixed a bug which stopped customers from using different door when entering and leaving some levels.
Fixed a bug which caused customers to get stuck after playing an arcade.
Fixed a bug which sometimes stopped you from placing carpets down behind transparent walls.
Fixed a bug which resulted in customers walking off screen when leaving the arcade.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
We have a great community on discord who have been a solid rocks, suggesting new ideas, testing for bugs and very enthusiastic about Arcade Tycoon. We want to say a big thanks to all these people. 

A couple people have been concerned about the delay of updates and leaving negative reviews we would like to say we are trying are best to update regularly, games take time and we are only a small team of 3.

[b]Want to get more involved?[/b]
